howto.what: 用户要求制作演示文稿时，Claude 会输出单文件 HTML 幻灯片：16:9 翻页、16 列网格、四种固定主题色（Klein Blue/Lemon/Mint/Safety Orange）选一、22 种固定版式，风格只用直角、无阴影渐变，字体限定 Inter 等。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作瑞士国际主义风格的演示，或表达事实、产品、分析、方法论类内容时触发。

howto.what_en: When asked to make a slideshow, Claude outputs a single-file HTML deck: 16:9 pages, 16-column grid, one of four fixed accent colors (Klein Blue/Lemon/Mint/Safety Orange), 22 fixed layouts, right angles only, no shadows/gradients, limited font set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests a Swiss International–style presentation, or content about facts, products, analysis, or methodology.

say_en.text: Make an 8-page product roadmap in Klein Blue.
